links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level of chatbot answers to COPD patient questions
links.effect: FKGL was well above typical patient reading levels for several questions: DeepSeek Q9 13.1, ChatGPT Q9 17.15, Gemini Q5 18.22 and Q9 17.42; Gemini produced more complex, academic-level answers on Q4, Q5, Q8.
links.quote: Gemini was observed to produce more complex and academic level answers on more questions (Q4, Q5, Q8).

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and accuracy of responses from three standard LLMs to frequent patient questions about COPD without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
